# configs/

* `default.yaml` — every tunable with its default, generated by `ldw config-template`
  (guarded by `tests/test_config_drift.py`; regenerate it when dataclass defaults
  change). Pass a (partial) copy with `--config` to `generate`, `embed`, `verify`,
  `controls` and `attack *`; sections are `generate:`, `embed:`, `verify:`,
  `controls:` and unknown keys warn.
* Evaluation profiles are **not** here: they ship inside the package
  (`ldw eval profiles --show quick`); copy one to a YAML file and pass its path to
  `ldw eval run --profile my.yaml` to customise.
